# Beach ball: r 0.27, red, white, yellow and mint segments. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new White --base-color 0.9922 1.0000 1.0000 --no-slot
material new Red --base-color 1.0000 0.2510 0.2510 --no-slot
material new Yellow --base-color 1.0000 0.9255 0.4275 --no-slot
material new Mint --base-color 0.0471 0.9059 0.6549 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Ball --subdivisions 2 --radius 0.27 --location 0.000 0.000 0.270
material assign White
active Ball
mode edit
select mode face
select none
select face where "pos.x > 0.1 && pos.z < 0.2"
material assign Red
select none
select face where "pos.x < -0.1 && pos.z < 0.2"
material assign Yellow
select none
select face where "abs(pos.x) <= 0.1 && pos.y < -0.12 && pos.z < 0.2"
material assign Mint
mode object
shade flat
export ball.glb
